Lemma
[The Sign of a Line is Decided by One of its Vectors]

Let $N$ be a one-dimensional subspace, let $B$ be bilinear, and suppose $0 e x\in N$ with $B(x,x)>0$. Then $B(v,v)>0$ for every nonzero $v\in N$.
Proof

\sketch Every nonzero $v\in N$ is $ax$ with $a e 0$, so $B(v,v)=a^2B(x,x)>0$.

□
